# Factro

> Factro is a Digital Manufacturing Platform (DMP) for regulated manufacturers — pharmaceuticals, medical devices, food & beverage, nutraceuticals, cosmetics, veterinary and API/CDMO. ERP, MES and QMS share one foundation, with compliance built into the architecture rather than configured on top of it.

Factro is built around three pillars: a Compliance Engine that enforces regulatory rules as system constraints rather than guidance documents, Task Manager, which routes work and handovers as tracked tickets with owners and clocks instead of email and verbal handoffs, and an Agentic RAG layer that surfaces genealogy, deviations and forecasts from the plant's own historical data instead of leaving it unread. The same core primitives satisfy every framework; an industry "pack" maps each one's clauses onto them.

## Industries

- [Pharmaceuticals](https://factro.io/industries/pharmaceuticals): 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, Revised Schedule M, PIC/S GMP, WHO, ICH Q10/GAMP 5.
- [Medical Devices](https://factro.io/industries/medical-devices): 21 CFR Part 820/QMSR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, EU MDR, Medical Devices Rules 2017.
- [Food & Beverage](https://factro.io/industries/food-beverage): FSSAI Schedule 4, Codex HACCP, FSSC 22000, 21 CFR Part 117, FSMA 204.
- [Nutraceuticals](https://factro.io/industries/nutraceuticals): 21 CFR Part 111, FSSAI health supplements, EU 2002/46/EC, EU 2015/2283.
- [Cosmetics](https://factro.io/industries/cosmetics): ISO 22716, MoCRA, EU Regulation 1223/2009, Cosmetics Rules 2020.
- [Veterinary](https://factro.io/industries/veterinary): EU 2025/2091, EU 2019/4, 21 CFR Parts 225/226, VICH GL60.
- [API & CDMO](https://factro.io/industries/api-cdmo): ICH Q7, EudraLex Volume 4 Part II, Revised Schedule M, WHO TRS 957.

A single site can carry more than one regulatory pack at once — see [all industries](https://factro.io/industries).

## Product

- [Pillars](https://factro.io/how-it-works): Compliance Engine, Task Manager and AI Agents on one page, including rulesets, approvals, task performance, private AI and interactive sample workflows.
- [ERP](https://factro.io/erp): Customer and vendor qualification, purchasing, inventory, storage, accounting and controlled masters. Explore the detailed capabilities on this product page.
- [MES](https://factro.io/mes): Production planning, guided execution, rooms, equipment, cleaning, sensor data and connectors.
- [QMS](https://factro.io/qms): Quality and LIMS, CAPA, documents, training, qualification and signed batch release.
- [Connected System](https://factro.io/one): ERP + MES + QMS on one record, with Work Management, Genealogy, CAPA, Unified Testing and Realtime Insights. Capability details live within each product page; there are no separate module pages.
- [Security & Trust](https://factro.io/security-trust): AWS-hosted in India (Mumbai/Hyderabad), per-tenant encryption, independently penetration tested, 99% uptime target.
